- name: Install and configure Prometheus node_exporter
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    node_exporter_version: '1.8.1'
    node_exporter_user: 'node_exporter'
    node_exporter_group: 'node_exporter'
    node_exporter_bin_dir: '/usr/local/bin'
    node_exporter_install_dir: '/usr/local/src'
    node_exporter_port: 9100
    node_exporter_listen_ip: '0.0.0.0'
    node_exporter_listen_address: '{{ node_exporter_listen_ip }}:{{ node_exporter_port }}'
    node_exporter_additional_flags: []
    node_exporter_service_name: 'node_exporter'
    node_exporter_checksum_file_tmp: '/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}-sha256sums.txt'

  tasks:
    - name: Assert Linux system
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - ansible_system == 'Linux'
        fail_msg: "This playbook supports Linux systems only."

    - name: Determine nologin shell path
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: /usr/sbin/nologin
      register: nologin_usr

    - name: Determine alternate nologin shell path
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: /sbin/nologin
      register: nologin_sbin

    - name: Set nologin shell fact
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        node_exporter_nologin_shell: "{{ '/usr/sbin/nologin' if nologin_usr.stat.exists else '/sbin/nologin' if nologin_sbin.stat.exists else '/bin/false' }}"

    - name: Create node_exporter group
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
        system: true

    - name: Create node_exporter user
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_user }}"
        group: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
        shell: "{{ node_exporter_nologin_shell }}"
        system: true
        create_home: false

    - name: Map architecture to Go arch
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        go_arch_map:
          x86_64: amd64
          aarch64: arm64
          arm64: arm64
          armv7l: armv7
          armv6l: armv6
          i386: '386'
          i686: '386'
          ppc64le: ppc64le
          s390x: s390x

    - name: Set Go architecture
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        go_arch: "{{ go_arch_map.get(ansible_architecture, 'amd64') }}"

    - name: Define URLs and filenames
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        node_exporter_base_url: "https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter/releases/download/v{{ node_exporter_version }}"
        node_exporter_tarball: "node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.linux-{{ go_arch }}.tar.gz"
        node_exporter_dir: "node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.linux-{{ go_arch }}"

    - name: Download node_exporter checksums
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ node_exporter_base_url }}/sha256sums.txt"
        dest: "{{ node_exporter_checksum_file_tmp }}"
        mode: '0644'

    - name: Read checksums file
      ansible.builtin.slurp:
        src: "{{ node_exporter_checksum_file_tmp }}"
      register: checksum_slurp

    - name: Extract checksum for tarball
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        node_exporter_checksum: "{{ ((checksum_slurp.content | b64decode).splitlines() | select('search', node_exporter_tarball + '$') | list | first).split()[0] }}"

    - name: Download node_exporter binary tarball
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ node_exporter_base_url }}/{{ node_exporter_tarball }}"
        dest: "/tmp/{{ node_exporter_tarball }}"
        mode: '0644'
        checksum: "sha256:{{ node_exporter_checksum }}"

    - name: Create install directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ node_exporter_install_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Extract node_exporter
      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/{{ node_exporter_tarball }}"
        dest: "{{ node_exporter_install_dir }}"
        remote_src: true

      ansible.builtin.copy:

        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0755'
        remote_src: true
      notify:

        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Prometheus Node Exporter
          Documentation=https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter
          Wants=network-online.target
          After=network-online.target

          [Service]
          User={{ node_exporter_user }}
          Group={{ node_exporter_group }}
          Type=simple
          ExecStart={{ node_exporter_bin_dir }}/node_exporter --web.listen-address={{ node_exporter_listen_address }}{% if node_exporter_additional_flags | length > 0 %} {{ node_exporter_additional_flags | join(' ') }}{% endif %}
          Restart=on-failure
          RestartSec=5s

          NoNewPrivileges=true
          ProtectSystem=strict
          ProtectHome=true
          PrivateTmp=true
          PrivateDevices=true
          ProtectHostname=true
          ProtectKernelTunables=true
          ProtectKernelModules=true
          ProtectControlGroups=true
          MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
          LockPersonality=true
          RestrictRealtime=true
          RestrictSUIDSGID=true
          SystemCallArchitectures=native
          RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_UNIX
          SystemCallFilter=~ @mount @privileged @resources
          CapabilityBoundingSet=
          AmbientCapabilities=

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
      notify:
        - reload systemd
        - restart node_exporter

    - name: Reload systemd to apply changes
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Ensure node_exporter service is enabled and running
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_service_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started

    - name: Gather service facts
      ansible.builtin.service_facts:

    - name: Open port {{ node_exporter_port }} in firewalld if running
      when:
        - ansible_facts.services is defined
        - "'firewalld.service' in ansible_facts.services"
        - ansible_facts.services['firewalld.service'].state == 'running'
      ansible.posix.firewalld:
        port: "{{ node_exporter_port }}/tcp"
        permanent: true
        state: enabled
        immediate: true

    - name: Remove downloaded tarball
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "/tmp/{{ node_exporter_tarball }}"
        state: absent

    - name: Remove downloaded checksums file
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ node_exporter_checksum_file_tmp }}"
        state: absent

  handlers:

      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true
